item.title: [−2] Foreign investors pull ₹44,166 crore from Indian equities in October; 2026 outflows top ₹3 lakh crore
item.description:
Selling follows ₹35,861 crore in September, with money moving to North Asian markets riding an AI rally. 2026 withdrawals reach ₹3.04 lakh crore. Escalating, though daily selling slowed late last week.

Banks & NBFCs: headwind (−2) — Most-owned by foreigners

Why it matters: Sustained outflows weigh on large banks and index heavyweights and add dollar demand that the RBI must offset from reserves.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows −2, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks
